fusions.name: Link After Link
fusions.desc: Throws your anchor chain, which deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second, then links to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Each enemy struck is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flail on a Tether
fusions.desc: Swings a shell plate on a length of chain at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shackled to You
fusions.desc: Chains up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles to your shell: they are pulled onto you and held there for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mail of Linked Scutes
fusions.desc: Conjures mail of linked scutes: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
